title: ISKCON Boston Ratha Yatra
description: Ratha Yatra, the Festival of Chariots, is one of the oldest and grandest Hindu festivals.
long_description:
Ratha Yatra, the Festival of Chariots, is one of the oldest and grandest Hindu festivals. Join the community for a colorful chariot procession, devotional music and dancing, cultural performances, and free vegetarian feast (prasadam). A spectacular celebration open to all.

This celebration takes place at ISKCON Boston in Boston, MA. All are welcome.
